::: {.callout-note}
## Standards used in this portfolio (ADaM)

This page documents the **current released CDISC ADaM standards** used to build the ADaM examples in this portfolio.  
These versions align with the **example datasets, specs, and metadata snapshots** included in this repo.
:::

## Core ADaM standards (current released)

| Standard / Artifact | Latest released version | Published | Why it matters |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| **ADaM (Model)** | **v2.1** | 2009-12-07 | Foundational ADaM principles and model concepts |
| **ADaMIG (Human Clinical Trials)** | **v1.3** | 2021-11-29 | Core analysis dataset structures/variables (ADSL, BDS) |
| **ADaM Conformance Rules** | **v5.0** | 2023-10-06 | Validation rule set used by conformance tools |
| **ADaM Metadata Submission Guidelines (ADaM-MSG)** | **v1.0** | 2023-04-18 | Guidance for the eCTD Module 5 “adam” folder/package |
| **ADaM Controlled Terminology (NCI EVS)** | **2025-09-26** | 2025-09-26 | Terminology package date used for codelists/values |

## Companion ADaM implementation guides (commonly used)

| Companion IG | Version | Published | Typical use |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| **Occurrence Data Structure (OCCDS) IG** | **v1.1** | 2021-11-29 | Occurrence-style analyses (AE/CM/MH-like structures) |
| **NCA Input Data (ADNCA) IG** | **v1.0** | 2021-11-29 | PK non-compartmental analysis inputs |
| **Medical Devices (ADaMIG-MD) IG** | **v1.0** | 2021-11-29 | Medical device analysis structures |
| **BDS for Time-to-Event (TTE) Analyses** | **v1.0** | 2016-02-12 | Time-to-event endpoints and censoring conventions |
| **BDS for popPK IG** | **v1.0** | 2023-10-06 | BDS extensions for population PK |

## High-signal examples (what reviewers love)

| Examples document | Version | Published | Why it’s useful |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| **ADaM Examples of Traceability** | **v1.0** | 2022-05-12 | Shows end-to-end traceability patterns (SDTM → ADaM → results) |
| **ADaM Oncology Examples** | **v1.0** | 2025-06-10 | Oncology-focused analysis approaches using ADaM structures |

## Portfolio conventions (how these are applied)

- **Baseline:** ADaM examples assume **ADaM v2.1** + **ADaMIG v1.3**.
- **Validation:** conformance checks reference **ADaM Conformance Rules v5.0** where applicable.
- **Terminology:** values align to the **CT package date** listed above.
- **Submission awareness:** always confirm required versions per sponsor/regulatory expectations.

::: {.callout-tip}
### Maintenance note
Controlled Terminology updates more frequently than ADaM/ADaMIG.  
When CT updates, change the **CT date** in the table (and optionally add a changelog entry).
:::
